# National Packers & Movers — Full Enterprise Knowledge Base

> India's premier relocation and logistics enterprise since 1987. Founded by Debabrata Jhampaty, headquartered in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, operating across 1,200+ Indian cities with company-owned lockable container fleets and permanent verified crews.

## Core Relocation Services
- [Household Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/household-relocation): Full home shifting, multi-layer 7-ply packing, furniture dismantling/assembly, and dedicated container transit.
- [Corporate Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/corporate-relocation): Minimal-downtime office relocation, server room moving, modular workstations, and secure document archiving.
- [Industrial Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/industrial-relocation): Heavy plant machinery, manufacturing equipment, raw material transport, and rigging services.
- [Vehicle Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/vehicle-relocation): Specialized enclosed car carriers and two-wheeler door-to-door transit with pre-loading photographic inspection.
- [Warehousing & Storage](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/warehousing-storage): 24/7 CCTV-monitored, moisture-controlled short and long-term storage facilities.
- [Transit Insurance](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/transit-insurance): 100% comprehensive declared-value transit protection policy against highway loss or damage.
- [Loading & Unloading](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/loading-unloading): Professional handling by permanent, background-verified packing crews using hydraulic equipment.

## High-Volume Moving Routes
- [Dhanbad to Kolkata Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/routes/dhanbad-to-kolkata): Daily dedicated container transit between Jharkhand and West Bengal.
- [Ranchi to Delhi Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/routes/ranchi-to-delhi): Direct interstate long-haul route connecting Jharkhand to NCR.
- [Singrauli to Delhi Logistics](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/routes/singrauli-to-delhi): Specialized industrial and officer relocation for power hubs.
- [All Interstate Routes](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/routes): Network of daily and weekly long-distance relocations across India.

## Compliance & Claim Documentation
- [PSU Billing & Claims Kit](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/billing-claim-kit): Approved documentation for Coal India (BCCL, ECL, CCL), SAIL, NTPC, SBI, Railways, and Central Government officer transfers.
  - 100% Tax-Compliant GST Invoice (SAC 9965 / 9967)
  - Official Consignment Note (Lorry Receipt / Bilty - LR)
  - Serialized Itemized Packing List with Declared Values
  - Official Money Receipt stamped and signed
